title: Trace European Red Spring residual readers
changes: Identify source-site evidence for the remaining E172 Red Spring sample and record a concrete extraction follow-up for original Thumb literal reads.
validation: Wine unit e232-redspring-residual-sites-av1hj_7p observes all 238 E221-unowned words during the retained 600 frames; 196 match original Thumb LDR opcodes and effective addresses. It protects the existing E221 dataset, ROM, state, input and native cache; Wine drains with the local Bluetooth overlay.
limitations: Instruction scopes may include nested HLE/DMA accesses; this is not proof of all callers, source extents, scene equivalence or consumption. The other 42 words, Linux, USA and native Windows remain open. No performance comparison was made.
